command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged reads against their pinned sha256 (reused from the 30x fixture) =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 4f43bf362b2391f03b2621226a04fb702b025d39b0a002ff2adf6d885dda4b86 reads_1.fq.gz
  printf '%s  %s\n' 93f4a67742e5509e8eabfc1966c384f5e3e7faadca866d7c20a8db817a48eca0 reads_2.fq.gz
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== seqkit stats (tab-delimited, deterministic) =="
seqkit stats -T reads_1.fq.gz reads_2.fq.gz > stats.tsv
cat reads_1.fq.gz reads_2.fq.gz > both.fq.gz   # a container-created file -- safe to make
seqkit stats -T both.fq.gz > both_stats.tsv
cat stats.tsv both_stats.tsv

# ---- smoke check (exact-or-wrong; reads are fixed, seqkit is deterministic) ----
# columns: 1 file 2 format 3 type 4 num_seqs 5 sum_len 6 min_len 7 avg_len 8 max_len
R1N=$(awk 'NR==2{print $4}' stats.tsv); R1L=$(awk 'NR==2{print $5}' stats.tsv)
R2N=$(awk 'NR==3{print $4}' stats.tsv); R2L=$(awk 'NR==3{print $5}' stats.tsv)
CN=$(awk 'NR==2{print $4}' both_stats.tsv); CL=$(awk 'NR==2{print $5}' both_stats.tsv)
MIN=$(awk 'NR==2{print $6}' stats.tsv); MAX=$(awk 'NR==2{print $8}' stats.tsv)
{
  echo "r1_num_seqs      $R1N   want 51933"
  echo "r1_sum_len       $R1L   want 7789950"
  echo "r2_num_seqs      $R2N   want 51933"
  echo "r2_sum_len       $R2L   want 7789950"
  echo "combined_num_seqs $CN   want 103866   (== r1+r2, conservation)"
  echo "combined_sum_len  $CL   want 15579900 (== r1+r2, conservation)"
  echo "read_len_uniform  min=$MIN max=$MAX   want 150/150"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$R1N" -eq 51933
test "$R1L" -eq 7789950
test "$R2N" -eq 51933
test "$R2L" -eq 7789950
test "$CN" -eq 103866
test "$CL" -eq 15579900
test "$CN" -eq $((R1N + R2N))     # conservation: the concatenation sums exactly
test "$CL" -eq $((R1L + R2L))
test "$MIN" -eq 150
test "$MAX" -eq 150
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
